- [Image #0] The image is a text passage that describes the behavior of amoebas. The transcribed text reads:

"Now the amoebas begin seeking out other amoebas to team up with. They begin communicating with one another (using chemical signals and trails). They use their mind-to-mind communication to coordinate their movements so that all the amoebas join up and clump together to form a large amoeba ball. This ball of hungry amoebas is called a superorganism. All the individual amoeba minds in the ball merge together to form an amoeba supermind. (This two-layer supermind sits on the second rung of the ladder of purpose, not the fourth rung alongside humankind.)"
